source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Before the deferred domain warm-up, please integrate the email with MeetAlfred and Hubspot. Also ensure that lists can be pushed from Hubspot to MeetAlfred.

routing_warnings.description: The separate clause requiring lists to be pushed from HubSpot to MeetAlfred belongs to the lead-synchronization Requirement.
The generic statement that 'The integration is now complete' does not unambiguously identify the campaign-email integration and should not be attached to this Requirement without tighter context.
